name: cmsintern
description: CMSINTERN — Hospital / Clinic Management System. Node.js + Express 5 + Prisma (MySQL) backend, React 19 + Vite + Redux Toolkit + Tailwind 4 frontend.

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:deploy: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:deploy && npm run seed
scripts.check:all: npm run check:backend-syntax && npm run check:frontend-build
scripts.firstrun: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:generate && echo "✅ Done! Configure backend/.env, then run: npm run dev"

author: CMSINTERN
